thread:
mia: Heads-up runtime — marketing needs a short, auditable benchmark pack for the launch blog. Two asks: (A) bench numbers/artifacts we can publish; (B) a tiny claims_audit.txt that maps numbers -> plain language claim for legal/product to review.

mia: Concrete checklist:
- Warmup run: linear ramp 10->120rps over 6m with small jitter, hold 120rps for 8m (~9k requests). Provide p50/p95/p99 + time series CSV.
- Coldstart sample: 2500 single-shot across fresh pods, heatmap + raw csv.
- Quant runs: fp16, q4_0, q5_1 (if q5_1 OOM fallback to q4_0 and log it).
- Tail-context smoke: 9k token prompts (30 samples) both cold KV and warm KV.
- Add a small A/B check: two prompt variants (friendly vs terse) for 20 samples to show qualitative parity.
- Include samples_manifest.json with seed, sample IDs, md5, and exact run commands.

rex: Quick Qs — model name? sampling seed? embargo?

mia: Model: "redwood-x-7b-lite". Use seed=2026 for sampling. Embargo until launch week; mark any experimental flags.

dana: We'll run on pool-2. Outputs we will upload: warmup_timeseries.csv, cold_heatmap.png, quant_report.csv, long_tail.csv, ab_compare.csv, samples_manifest.json, claims_audit.txt, runbook.txt, warmup_blog.png. We'll include hardware provenance (instance type, CUDA, driver) and peak GPU mem.

product-bot: Note: product asked claims_audit.txt to include short recommended phrasing and a 1-line caveat about sample representativeness.

dana: Example curl we'll include in manifest (token redacted):

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-x-7b-lite","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}'
```

runtime-bot: Scheduling jobs: job-warmup-55421, job-cold-55422, job-quant-55423, job-ab-55424 on pool-2. ETA full artifacts 18-30h. Logs: https://internal.redwood/bench/runs/55421.

rex: If any quant variant fails we want an explicit note in claims_audit.txt with fallback and impact on latency/cost. Also please add MD5 checks for every artifact for provenance.

dana: Copy. I'll post S3 paths + MD5s here when uploads finish and tag @mia @rex. If marketing needs a preview PNG earlier I can run a 1k warmup_preview and drop warmup_preview.png by EOD.

mia: Perfect — preview would help with copy testing. Thanks!
